name: Embedded motion film
definition: In-deck animated film with play controls, numbered scenes, a scrubber and an expandable caption transcript.

demo.how: A 40-second film drawn with CSS plays inside the slide (at 4× speed here). Play or pause it, drag the scrubber or use its arrow keys, or jump with the numbered scene buttons; Transcript shows the caption for the current scene. Reset rewinds to the start.
